description: This file defines a REST controller in a Spring Boot application for managing discussion threads and posts within a Learning Management System (LMS). It provides endpoints to list and create discussion threads in courses, as well as list and add posts within threads.

classes.name: DiscussionController
classes.description: Spring REST controller for discussion-related endpoints in the LMS backend.

methods.name: threads
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list discussion threads for a course.

methods.name: createThread
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new discussion thread in a course.

methods.name: posts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list posts within a discussion thread.

methods.name: addPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new post to a discussion thread.
